title: SleepAnyway
description: Allows you to sleep even when monsters are nearby
body:
**SleepAnyway**

Tired of hearing "You can't sleep now, there are monsters nearby"?

**SleepAnyway** removes the monster proximity check when sleeping, letting you use beds freely regardless of nearby hostile mobs.

## Features

- **Sleep through danger** — Monsters near your bed no longer prevent you from sleeping
- **Server-side only** — Install on the server; no client installation needed

All my mods are completely free to use.
